card.name: Spots just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: Spaces and small words right before a number or dose in pediatric dosing tables, such as after an infection name or "of". Also on "is" or "as" in short statements about what is normal or what signs to watch for.

modes.label: Before dose numbers
modes.description: The blank space or unit just before a dose, interval or duration in pediatric dosing lines.
modes.example: Infants 29 days to 2 years of age: the recommended dosage of Acetaminophen Injection is<< >>15 mg/kg every 6 hours

modes.label: Plain-language statements
modes.description: The word "is" or "as" in patient advice about what is normal or which signs to look for.
modes.example: This<< is>> normal, and not a reason for antibiotics

card.writes: It pushes toward words like "usually" and "generally", which suggests a typical or standard statement follows.
card.plain: It marks places where the text is about to give a usual dose or a typical, expected course.
